name: GCP Instance Containment
creator: 3139d5f3-4dbb-44be-81dc-02207261b23c
description: This block stops running GCP Compute VM instances, shutting them down gracefully and allowing them to be restarted later if needed. It uses a boolean input to control manual or automatic execution and returns the containment result, false on failure, or an empty value if no action is taken.

steps.name: GoogleCloudCompute_Stop Instance
steps.description: Stops a running instance, shutting it down cleanly, and allows you to restart the instance at a later time. Stopped instances do not incur VM usage charges while they are stopped. However, resources that the VM is using, such as persistent disks and static IP addresses, will continue to be charged until they are deleted.
